= Cloud August 28, 2026

_August 28, 2026_

[NOTE]
====
Kobiton now uses date-based release versioning. Instead of version numbers such as 4.26S or 4.19.3, releases are identified by date. Build numbers use a format such as 202608.28, and release notes display the corresponding date as August 28, 2026.

== Appium AI enhancements

*Highlights*

- *New: Anthropic Claude models* — set `LlmApiFormat=AnthropicMessages` with an Anthropic `BaseUrl`, API key, and model name. Refusals (`stop_reason=refusal`) and truncations (`stop_reason=max_tokens`) surface as clear errors instead of returning partial text.
- *New: Kobiton-hosted LLM gateway* (`llm.kobiton.com`) — set `LlmApiFormat=KobitonChatCompletions` and `BaseUrl=https://llm.kobiton.com/v1`. On Kobiton-linked deployments, the gateway can inherit the tenant's platform API key when no explicit `LlmClient.ApiKey` is configured; an explicit key always wins.
- Full-resolution screenshots are now sent to the LLM by default, matching the resolution the accuracy benchmarks were measured at. To restore the previous 1080 px downscale (for example to reduce bandwidth or per-request cost), set `NaturalLanguageLocator.KeepOriginalScreenshot=false` in `dc.ini`.
- Two vision coordinate-space conventions are now supported: `Pixel` (default; compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic Claude) and `Normalized 0-1000` (used by Qwen3-VL and Gemini-class models). Set globally via `NaturalLanguageLocator.VisionCoordSpace=Normalized` in `dc.ini`, or per-session via the `kobiton:visioncoordspace=Normalized` capability. An invalid value fails session creation with a message listing valid values.
- *Breaking change: `LlmClient.Temperature` removed.* Newer models (gpt-5.6 and above) reject the `temperature` request parameter with HTTP 400, so hard-coding it was no longer viable. To send `temperature` — or any other model-specific parameter — use the new `LlmClient.TextExtraBody` / `LlmClient.VisionExtraBody` settings, which pass a JSON object verbatim into the request body. Per-session equivalents: `kobiton:llmtextextrabody` / `kobiton:llmvisionextrabody`. Migration example: replace `LlmClient.Temperature=0` with `LlmClient.TextExtraBody={"temperature": 0}`.
- Sessions that override the LLM base URL (`kobiton:llmbaseurl`) must now provide their own API key (`kobiton:llmapikey`). Session setup fails with an explicit error if the base URL is overridden without a session-provided key. Sessions that don't override the base URL inherit the server-configured key exactly as before.

== Restricted ADB shell

- On Public Cloud devices, `kobiton device adb-shell` is now more permissive: pipes, redirection, quoted arguments, whitespace in arguments, and a broader set of commands and file paths are accepted. Dangerous patterns (interactive shell, `..` path traversal, oversized command lines, unsafe write targets) are still rejected.
- On Public Cloud Android devices, the `adb shell` toolbar in Portal manual sessions now uses the same policy as the CLI.

== Kobiton CLI

- New: CLI sessions are now supported on public cloud devices. Previously public cloud restricted CLI session starts.
- Fixed the Direct Hub not propagating CLI failures for unsafe-directory pushes. These failures were silently hidden — they are now surfaced to the caller, matching the CLI's error-propagation fix from earlier releases.

== deviceConnect

- Fixed a network-capture burst deadlocking a session's upstream writes and freezing screenshots.
- Xiaomi devices now stay awake for the duration of long automation runs. Xiaomi's aggressive deep-idle behavior previously suspended sessions mid-run.
